verdict.rationale: BigCommerce heavily markets itself as API-first, offering REST/GraphQL APIs to build apps, automate store processes, and support headless storefronts (bigcommerce-docs-4, bigcommerce-docs-25, bigcommerce-docs-18), which implies broad API coverage of platform functionality. However, no evidence explicitly confirms full UI/API parity, and a community report cites unreliable API connectivity with throttling issues (bigcommerce-comm-4), undercutting confidence that every UI action is reliably scriptable via API. missing for 10: explicit documentation/statement of complete UI-to-API parity, independent verification that all admin-UI actions are exposed via API, and resolution of the throttling/reliability complaint.
